The open_vocabulary_detector's 9 flamingo bounding boxes were correctly interpreted as over-detection of 6 actual entities (with overlapping/confident boxes). The animal_pose_auditor's HIGH risk assessment (66% low-confidence keypoints) was appropriately weighted in authenticity scoring. The fine_grained_classifier results for sheep (ram/tup top prediction) and flamingo (incorrectly predicting ram/tup) were considered but didn't change atom verdicts since object presence was visually confirmed.

The major failures (wrong count, wrong material, missing action verb) appropriately drove down alignment_score to 2.73.
